goal: Specify native graph interaction states for pan, zoom, selection, detail sheets, edit affordances, and review parity.
non_goals: Do not use WebView graph carry-over.
Do not waive graph P0 behavior without approval.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness unless this is an explicitly approved Phase 6 readiness task with complete evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Graph interaction spec covers pan, zoom, node selection, edge affordances, detail sheet behavior, edit/review states, and empty/error states.
Native Canvas/Compose expectations are explicit and WebView carry-over is excluded.
Dependencies on graph engine, graph edit parity, and UX foundation work are recorded.
No prohibited package/signing/PWA release changes are made.
verification_expectations: Validate the interaction/state matrix is internally consistent with Phase 5 graph ownership.
Run JSON validation for modified ADworkflo specs.
If UI files are changed by the future worker, run Compose/UI state tests where available and capture screenshots when feasible.
notes: Added as a Phase 5 UI/UX follow-up to split graph interaction decisions out of the broad NATIVE-UX-005 surface task.
Use deterministic tests and fakes; real LLM/provider/network/device actions require explicit scope and evidence.
